556:t_6:56.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I want to stay like this forever...)

556:t_6:57.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Everyone's going to see us... It's embarrassing, super embarrassing... But... I don't care anymore...)

556:t_6:58.en:
$$かなめ$$
(My love keeps growing bigger and bigger... I can't stop, I can't stop it...)

556:t_6:59.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I... always wanted to do this. He must have, too...)

556:t_6:64.en:
$$宗介$$
「As long as I have you, I don't need weapons.」

556:t_6:65.en:
$$かなめ$$
(This is the world I chose... The world where I'm going to live... with $$宗介$$...)

556:t_6:69.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Bridge ～

556:t_6:70.en:
$$キャシー$$
「...Survival of Sergeant $$相良宗介$$ confirmed. I'm sending a unit to recover the $$レーバテイン$$.」

556:t_6:72.en:
$$ボビー$$
「I'm so glad, Captain $$テッサ$$.」

556:t_6:75.en:
$$テッサ$$
(I thought I would sob my heart out, yet here I am, calm...)

556:t_6:76.en:
$$テッサ$$
(But surely, someday, the time will come when I suffer. The one who brought about his death was none other than me...)

556:t_6:77.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Even a brother like that... was the last family I had left...)

556:t_6:78.en:
$$ミーナ#pt169$$
「...Also, here is the list of those killed in this battle.」

556:t_6:79.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We must not let their noble sacrifice be in vain.」

556:t_6:81.en:
$$ラム$$
「Captain! Incoming message from Director $$大塚$$ of the Far East Branch!」

556:t_6:82.en:
$$ラム$$
「It seems to be an effect of the earlier $$時空震動|lc$$, but a distortion in the dimensional boundary line has appeared at the edge of $$地球圏$$!」

556:t_6:83.en:
$$ラム$$
「They report that a force thought to be $$バアル$$ has emerged from it!」

556:t_6:84.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All ships, stand by! Once we finish minimum resupply, $c will go up into space!」

556:t_6:87.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$レナード$$... This world that you and $$カリーニン$$ called distorted, we will protect it.)

556:t_6:88.en:
$$テッサ$$
(That is the responsibility of us who stopped your ambition, and the mission of $c.)

556:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How about that, $n! The $$Ｚクリスタル$$ and I played a part in $$宗介$$'s safe return!」

556:t_10:9.en:
$n
「It was $$レナード$$'s attack on the $$クォーター$$... Because of that...」

556:t_10:11.en:
$n
「...Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$... $$宗介$$ survived partly thanks to you.」

556:t_10:12.en:
$n
「When he and $$千鳥$$ show their faces over here, tell them I said hello.」

556:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I had planned a welcome-back-$$かなめ$$ commemorative sale for today, but the mood is hardly right for that.」

556:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll put off the celebration for our ace pilots until another occasion as well.」

556:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So... today, in mourning for $$ティティ$$, I'll quietly... do business. Business, business...」

557:t_000:0.en:
$$ダヴ$$
「Quite a sight, Boss. It's truly the big decisive battle.」

557:t_000:2.en:
$$Ｔボーン$$
「What's wrong, Boss? Not feeling it?」

557:t_000:3.en:
$$ベック$$
「That jerk $$ゲイツ$$ went and died, and that jerk $$カン・ユー$$ is missing...」

557:t_000:4.en:
$$ベック$$
「We've been scraping by small-time without the patron, but maybe this is the time to call it quits...」

557:t_000:5.en:
$$ダヴ$$
「You're leaving $$ファイヤバグ$$, Boss!?」

557:t_000:6.en:
$$ベック$$
「First off, there's $$アマルガム$$. I just can't get into this operation.」

557:t_000:7.en:
$$Ｔボーン$$
「That's bad, Boss. We're about to have the decisive battle with $c, and if we desert in front of the enemy...」

557:t_000:8.en:
$$ベック$$
「You guys... Do you know what that silver-haired pretty boy is planning to do?」

557:t_000:10.en:
$$ベック$$
「Wrong. I only just found out myself, by tapping the talk of the brass upstairs...」

557:t_000:11.en:
$$ベック$$
「Looks like those bastards are planning to carry out $$時空修復|lc$$.」

557:t_000:13.en:
$$ベック$$
「Well... whatever. All that happens is a new parallel world gets made, and the me over there lives on without knowing a thing.」

557:t_000:14.en:
$$ベック$$
「But that me won't know that the world he's living in was made by somebody for their own convenience, either...」

557:t_000:15.en:
$$ベック$$
「It pisses me off. In short, that me is someone who's had his past... his memories... stolen.」

557:t_000:17.en:
$$ベック$$
「Heh... just me complaining. Our guests are about to make their entrance.」

557:t_001:0.en:
$$ベック$$
「Here you come, you bunch of layabouts.」

557:t_001:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I never expected you to be the welcoming committee, $$ベック$$.」

557:t_001:2.en:
$$ベック$$
「I'm not doing it because I like it, but this is that damn old bond of ours for you.」

557:t_001:3.en:
$$ベック$$
「I'll make it as flashy as I possibly can!」

557:t_001:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Captain! The dimensional boundary line across this whole area is already showing abnormal warping!」

557:t_001:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Has their plan already begun?」

557:t_001:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We have to stop $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ and $$千鳥かなめ$$ as quickly as possible!」

557:t_001:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「First, we take out the enemy interception force.」

557:t_001:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「ASes, mobile suits, and $$ファイヤバグ$$...! To think they gathered this many!」

557:t_001:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That must be thanks to $$アマルガム$$ having ties to all sorts of organizations.」

557:t_001:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Outfoxing even the Empire to pull all this off... They've got some guts.」

557:t_001:14.en:
$$アスカ$$
「You heard them say the dimensional boundary line is warping! You're the one who volunteered to sortie, so pull yourself together!」
